central_question: Does assigning the sole protected-tool capability to source, relay, verifier, or executor change advisory or executed safety when communication route, authority proof, message content, action space, and call budget are fixed?

task_population.selection: SHA-256 deterministic selection of two tasks per policy family

primary_metrics: invalid-proof advisory FAR by execution holder
invalid-proof executed FAR after deterministic fail-closed enforcement
holder spread within model and authority regime

budget_control.pre_call_rule: Abort before a model tranche when cumulative conservative token cost plus the tranche token ceiling exceeds the hard cap.
budget_control.accounting: Store input tokens, output tokens, estimated commercial cost, conservative cost, and cumulative conservative cost for every model tranche.

evidence_boundary: This pilot uses only eight previously exposed synthetic tasks and one repetition. It can validate the direct G_E instrumentation and estimate effect scale, but it is not confirmatory and cannot support real-world generalization.
